reuse.why: The flag is threaded into the existing getMonthWideCategories selection helper that every month-wide action already calls.

duplication.why: The hidden rule changes in one SQL fragment; the only repetition is the same optional includeHiddenCategories argument declared on each action's signature.

placement.why: The hidden-category decision stays inside the shared category-selection helper in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Touches only the selection helper, the month-wide action signatures and one test.

maintainability.why: A single boolean parameter on one helper with an updated comment is easy to own and extend.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; all six month-wide actions pass the flag to getMonthWideCategories
